label: Remote SFTP backup destination
summary: Prepare restricted off-server backup transfers with pinned server identity and verified recovery.
core_boundary: Baseline SFTP/file management and local recovery remain Core functions; this adds optional remote backup orchestration only. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Pin the remote server identity and scope the dedicated account to an admitted backup destination.
Refuse path traversal, link escape, foreign backup deletion and unapproved destination changes.
Exercise interrupted transfers and verify archive integrity before a clean-target restore is accepted.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
